title: Core spec: remove 5 per-aggregate max* fields, switch MUST-NOT-exceed clauses to overQuota, cite RFC 9425
description:
Edit draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md to:

1. Remove from the account-level capability object (around lines 165-178):
   - maxGroupMembers
   - maxSpaceMembers
   - maxRolesPerSpace
   - maxChannelsPerSpace
   - maxCategoriesPerSpace
   Keep maxBodyBytes, maxAttachmentBytes, maxAttachmentsPerMessage.

2. Rewrite each MUST-NOT-exceed clause to specify the standard overQuota SetError pattern (no custom error types). Affected sites:

   Line ~886 (Chat/set, creating a group Chat):
     'Total membership including the owner MUST NOT exceed maxGroupMembers.'
     → 'If the resulting membership would exceed a server-defined limit on the number of members per group Chat, the server MUST return an overQuota SetError ({{RFC8620}} §5.3).'

   Line ~903 (Chat/set, updating group membership):
     'Total membership after addition MUST NOT exceed maxGroupMembers.'
     → analogous overQuota replacement, preserve the Peer/groupUpdate sentence.

   Line ~1096 (Space/set, creating roles):
     'Total MUST NOT exceed maxRolesPerSpace.'
     → 'If the resulting role count would exceed a server-defined limit on the number of roles per Space, the server MUST return an overQuota SetError ({{RFC8620}} §5.3).'
     Preserve the position/manage_roles enforcement sentence.

   Line ~1105 (Space/set, creating members):
     'Total MUST NOT exceed maxSpaceMembers.'
     → analogous overQuota replacement (members per Space).

   Line ~1114 (Space/set, creating channels):
     'Total channel count MUST NOT exceed maxChannelsPerSpace.'
     → analogous overQuota replacement (channels per Space).

   Line ~1123 (Space/set, creating categories):
     'Total MUST NOT exceed maxCategoriesPerSpace.'
     → analogous overQuota replacement (categories per Space).

3. Add a short integration paragraph in the capability section (after the surviving max* fields) or as a new subsection titled 'Resource Limits and Quotas':

   'Servers enforce implementation-defined limits on the number of group Chat members, Space members, roles, channels, and categories. Where such a limit would be exceeded, the server MUST return an overQuota SetError ({{RFC8620}} §5.3) on the relevant create entry. Servers MAY surface their chat-resource quotas (Space, Chat, Channel, Role, Category, ChatMember, SpaceMember object counts) at the account scope via JMAP Quotas ({{RFC9425}}); per-aggregate enforcement remains as specified above.'

4. Update the Denial of Service security section (line ~1460):
   'Enforce maxAttachmentsPerMessage, maxGroupMembers, and maxSpaceMembers at creation and update time.'
   → 'Enforce maxAttachmentsPerMessage at creation and update time. Servers MUST also enforce implementation-defined caps on group Chat membership, Space membership, roles, channels, and categories at Chat/set and Space/set time, returning overQuota SetErrors as specified in those methods.'

5. References:
   - Confirm RFC 8620 is already a normative reference (it is).
   - Update JMAP-QUOTAS informative reference: currently points to 'draft-ietf-jmap-quotas'; replace with RFC 9425. (Single-line ref-block fix; in scope as we're now citing it from the body.)

6. No new SetError types. No new IANA registrations. No 'tooMany*' vocabulary.

7. After edits, grep the repo for stale references:
   grep -rE 'max(Group|Space)Members|max(Roles|Channels|Categories)PerSpace' --include='*.md'
   Expected: zero matches outside OLD/.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rE 'max(Group|Space)Members|max(Roles|Channels|Categories)PerSpace' across all *.md files outside OLD/ returns zero matches. All five MUST-NOT-exceed clauses cite overQuota and RFC 8620 §5.3. Quotas integration paragraph cites RFC 9425. Capability object lists only maxBodyBytes, maxAttachmentBytes, maxAttachmentsPerMessage. No new SetError types are defined; the IANA section is unchanged except possibly for the JMAP-QUOTAS reference update. Federation draft's reference to maxBodyBytes is preserved. Guides have no references to removed fields (verify via grep).
close_reason:

2. Rewrote 6 MUST-NOT-exceed clauses (Chat/set create group + addMembers, Space/set addRoles + addMembers + addChannels + addCategories) to return standard overQuota SetError per RFC 8620 §5.3
3. Rewrote the Quotas integration paragraph (was at line 188): updated citation to RFC9425, fixed pre-existing 'datatypes' → 'types' field name bug, expanded scope text to explain per-aggregate enforcement
4. Updated Denial of Service security section (was at line 1460) to drop enumerated maxes, refer to per-method overQuota
5. References block: added RFC9425 bare entry (informative, numerically ordered), removed stale JMAP-QUOTAS draft entry

Verification:

- grep for 'MUST NOT exceed' returns zero in core spec
- grep for JMAP-QUOTAS returns zero in core spec (still present in filenode — follow-up filed)
- Federation draft's maxBodyBytes references at lines 225, 258 preserved
- Guides have no references to removed fields
- 7 overQuota citations in core spec (1 in integration paragraph + 6 in method bullets, matching plan)
- README has no max* references (already clean)

Zero new SetError types defined. Zero new IANA registrations. Single file touched.
